tasks.goal: Implement one concrete Plaesy-vs-Hindsight capability gap in /home/ubuntu/cli: an opt-in `plaesy memory answer <query>` command that retrieves cited local passages then synthesizes a response using only an explicitly selected existing configured delegate provider. Must be read-only; require existing billable provider confirmation; no provider/config/credential changes; do not call live model in tests. Evidence citations must be printed independently from model prose; prompt must mark memory pass
